text_block_list.text:
The day of the Tenno Sho (Autumn). Tokyo 
Racecourse was overflowing with people, 
and cheers were flying back and forth even 
before the race.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaah! Go for it, Oguri Cap!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Show 'em what you're made of, Tamamo 
Cross! Crush that monster and keep the 
winning streak alive!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...In this Tenno Sho, the showdown at the 
summit between Oguri Cap and Tamamo Cross 
will take place."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I had gathered information beforehand, but 
seeing it up close, the passion is far 
beyond my imagination.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross, the "White Lightning", kept 
persevering for the sake of the family who 
supported and sent her off, despite their 
poverty.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"And her hard work bore fruit; since 
setting a graded-race course record, she's 
been on a winning streak. She took 
everyone by storm, and her momentum 
remains unstoppable."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap-san, on the other hand, is a 
superstar who burst forth from the 
regional circuit like a comet.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
She belongs to the same Classic generation 
as me, but... honestly, far more people 
know her name than ours.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
In other words, that also serves as proof 
of just how extraordinary her races have 
been.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
And that concludes the Chiyo 
Investigation!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone here is so strong, aren't 
they?
choice_data_list: But you're not going to lose either

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. I can't afford to lose.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I cannot yield this single race. After 
all, I declared that I would show a truly 
formidable run.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: So that I can become your rival, too.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Here I am. Tokyo Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Ogurin, you can't lose! The legend starts 
from here!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo, you're our top dog! Show 'em that 
raw grit and carve the spirit of Naniwa 
into their souls!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yes, they're the ones who deserve the 
spotlight. There's no room for me to 
squeeze in there.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I know in my head that I should just walk 
away already.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sorry. If I run with you, I'll lose 
my future..."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"...I wasn't supposed to exist in anyone's 
future. Even though I'm someone whose 
shadow is already fading."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Is it okay for me to look forward to a 
future running with you? Is it really okay 
to dream such a late dream...?

Amidst an intersection of various prayers, 
the Tenno Sho (Autumn) begins—
